figurative_meaning_en: Something knowable or understandable; the beginning-to-end sequence or logical structure of a statement
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গল্পের মাথামুণ্ডু বুঝতে পারছি না।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech has no head or tail.
I can't make head or tail of this story.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to the absence of logical flow, akin to a headless or tailless entity.
